title: Envitefy — Mom, Just Snap It!
status: V3 exports technically and visually reviewed; one shared production with two responsive layouts.
sharedMedia: One selected source per shot, one common final audio WAV, shared product captures, editable text and official logo. Both compositions use the same scene component and timing data.
direction: Premium cinematic hand-drawn 2D anime; warm peach afternoon light in a cream-and-terracotta family kitchen. Mother: warm brown skin, chestnut wavy shoulder-length hair, teal knit top and ivory apron. Daughter: same family complexion, dark brown high ponytail, coral school cardigan over white shirt, navy skirt, lavender backpack. Expressive, charming, family friendly, continuous character motion.
framingPlan: 16:9 original animated clips: faces, hands, invitation and fridge actions inside central 45 percent. Horizontal uses full wider kitchen and a side-by-side large demo. Vertical uses shot-specific close reframes in tall story windows; product phone takes most of vertical frame. No flattened character repositioning or whole-export crops. Lettering, captions, interface and branding are separate editor layers.
